verdict.rationale: Azure publishes an official Pricing Calculator (azure.microsoft.com/pricing/calculator) and public pricing pages under azure.microsoft.com/pricing covering pay-as-you-go purchase options and free services, all usable before signing up. One community comment calls the pricing 'opaque', but that is general criticism and does not contradict the published pages or calculator. Missing for 10: evidence of individual per-service pricing pages (the pack shows only page titles), detail on what the calculator can estimate for a multi-service stack, and independent hands-on corroboration of using the calculator.
